tuileries.definition:
n. palace and royal residence built for Catherine de Medicis in 1564 and burned down in 1871; all that remains today are the formal gardens
n. formal gardens next to the Louvre in Paris
tuileries.translation: n. [the Tuileries]杜伊勒里宫(巴黎旧王宫,1871年被焚毁,现作公园 Tuileries Gardens)

tuileries gardens.translation: [网络] 杜乐丽花园；杜伊勒里花园；杜特勒里花园

tuileries palace.translation: [网络] 杜伊勒里宫；杜乐丽宫；丢勒里宫苑

tuille.definition: n armor plate that protects the hip and thigh

tuinal.translation: n. [药]吐诺尔(由阿米妥及速可眠合成, 用作镇静剂或催眠剂)[商标名]

tuite.translation: [人名] [爱尔兰姓氏] 图特好像是住所名称，但一直被认为是盖尔语姓氏的英语形式，来源于人名，含义是“大牙猎犬”(largetoothed hound)
